zh: 看板管理菜单在右键关闭和删除失败后取消时恢复触发按钮焦点，菜单动效读取外壳的统一曲线。调用可选能力前复用设置模型检查提供方，缺席时组件可继续选择其它提供方；成功预检使用有界缓存，正式调用继续核对宿主授权。运行成本缩略卡在矮盒中收起明细，保留示例标识和主要读数。
en: Board management returns focus after dismissing a context menu or cancelling a failed deletion, and inherits the shared motion curve. Optional capability calls check provider availability through the settings model, with a bounded successful-preflight cache and host authorization on every call. Short usage previews hide details while retaining the sample label and primary reading.
